description: The booking plan for one weekend, in booking order: items (flights, hotel and bookable steps; scarcest first) each with kind, title, when (date YYYY-MM-DD and local time HH:MM), the affiliate-tracked partner url with dates, party size and time prefilled where the partner supports it, provider, estimated_cost {cents, currency} for the whole party, reserve_days, book_by (YYYY-MM-DD), fallback and alternatives [{provider, url}]: other sites that book the same item (the hotel on Klook beside Booking.com), not additional items; plus needs_from_user (traveller names, contact, payment approval), a sequence_note, the total estimate in integer cents, cancellation_advice and a disclosure that the links are affiliate links. Escape the Week takes no payment: every booking and payment is made on the partner's site. Prices are estimates, not quotes.

city.description: City slug from list_cities, e.g. lisbon.

friday.description: The Friday of the weekend as a YYYY-MM-DD date (it must be a Friday); the weekend runs Friday to Monday. Enables a real fare.

lang.description: BCP 47 language of the published text, e.g. es (default English).

origin.description: Origin slug from list_origins, e.g. barcelona; adds flights.

party.description: Who is travelling, to check the persona fits (optional); never changes a price.

persona.description: Persona slug from list_personas, e.g. foodie.

tier.description: Budget tier, cheapest to most lavish (default modest). Scales every price line.

travellers.description: Group size, 1-20 (default 2). Prices are for the whole group.

name: booking_manifest
title: Booking plan
